meta.notes: phones-us-1: Motorola and Nothing phones, foldables and companion audio/wearables sold on the brands' official US stores (motorola.com/us, us.nothing.tech). Researched 2026-09-28. Prices are the official US store prices on that date; where the store shows a sale, `price` is the sale price and `compareAt` the list price. Motorola colour names drop the 'PANTONE' prefix. OnePlus was in the brief but is intentionally absent: oneplus.com/us posts a 'Notice of Business Adjustment' (OnePlus has concluded product rollouts in North America) and every US store listing (OnePlus 15, 15R, Buds 4, Buds Pro 3, Watch 3, Pad accessories) is out of stock or 'stop sale'. Nothing Ear (3) and Headphone (1) are already in audio.json and were skipped.
